wikipediaExtract: The NSM-brug (bridge 356) is a bascule bridge located in the Klaprozenweg and spans the Zijkanaal I in Amsterdam-Noord. The bridge that was opened on April 22, 2018 is the third version.

name: Brug 707
wikipediaExtract: Brug 707 is a structure in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: Weesperbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Weesperbrug is a fixed steel arch bridge over the Amsterdam-Rijnkanaal and forms part of the provincial road N236.

name: Lijnderbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Lijnderbrug is a lift bridge between the Amsterdamse Baan (T106) in Lijnden (Haarlemmermeer municipality) in the province of North Holland and the Ookmeerweg (s106) in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The bridge spans, at more than 4 meters high, the Ringvaart of the Haarlemmermeerpolder and the Akerdijk, 500 meters southeast of the De Lynden Pump Station.

name: Torontobrug
wikipediaExtract: The Torontobrug (bridge 350) in Amsterdam is a double bascule bridge on the border between Amsterdam-Zuid, De Pijp and Amsterdam-Oost. It spans the Amstel. On the west side it lies along the Stadhouderskade and is perpendicular to the Amsteldijk (formerly Utrechtsezijde). On the east side it lies along the Mauritskade.

name: Yaa Adu-Ampomabrug
wikipediaExtract: The Yaa Adu-Ampomabrug, called the Reigersbospadbrug until 2023, is a structure in Amsterdam-Zuidoost.

name: Oude Haagsebrug
wikipediaExtract: The Oude Haagsebrug (bridge no. 1864) was a bridge over the Ringvaart of the Haarlemmermeer on the route between Amsterdam, via the hamlet of Nieuwe Meer, and Schiphol. The road over this bridge is the Oude Haagseweg, the former Rijksweg 4.

name: Veeneikbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Veeneikbrug is a bicycle and pedestrian bridge that connects pedestrians and cyclists between the Bijlmerweide in Amsterdam-Zuidoost (west) and the Diemerbos in Diemen (east). The bridge crosses the Provincial road N236 (Amsterdam side), the Gaasp/Weespertrekvaart and the Stammerdijk (Diemer side).

name: Hugo de Vriesbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Hugo de Vriesbrug (bridge 457) is a structure in Amsterdam-Oost. Although numbered as a bridge, it is a viaduct or tunnel depending on the point of view. The structure spans the Hugo de Vrieslaan and is located in the Gooiseweg.

name: Tijnmuidenbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Tijnmuidenbrug, designated KW517, is a structure in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The structure is located on the Westrandweg, part of the A5 motorway. It spans the Amsterdam traffic road Dortmuiden. The architectural firm Zwarts & Jansma Architecten was responsible for the design of this national road and all its structures.

Bridge 1127 is a structure in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The bridge is a so-called culvert bridge. It was laid in 1968/1969 in a wide drainage ditch between the G-District with Geerdinkhof and the Bijlmerweide park. The park and the water were laid out around half of the neighbourhood.

name: Ringvaartbrug A5
wikipediaExtract: The Ringvaartbrug A5, designated as Kunstwerk 511, is a structure in the province of North Holland. The structure is located on the Rijksweg 5 / Westrandweg and crosses the Ringvaart of the Haarlemmermeer. The architectural firm Zwarts & Jansma Architecten was responsible for the design of this national road and all its structures.

name: Kattenburgerbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Kattenburgerbrug (bridge 274) is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The wide traffic bridge forms the connection between on one side the Prins Hendrikkade and the Kadijksplein (both southwest) and on the other side the Kattenburgerstraat, Kattenburgerplein and the Kattenburgergracht (northeast).

name: Gwijde van Henegouwenbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Gwijde van Henegouwenbrug (bridge 805) is a structure in Amsterdam-Zuid. The bridge dates back to 1960/1962 when architect Dirk Sterenberg worked for the Department of Public Works. He was allowed to design all the foot and bicycle bridges in the Gijsbrecht van Aemstelpark and even lay out the Ontmoetingseiland.

name: Paleis voor Volksvlijtbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Paleis voor Volksvlijtbrug (bridge no. 248) is a fixed bridge on the boundary of Amsterdam-Centrum and Amsterdam Oud-Zuid. It connects the Westeinde on the north side with the Stadhouderskade, the south quay of the Singelgracht, and the Van Woustraat, spanning the Singelgracht. Tram line 4 runs over it.

name: Muntsluis
wikipediaExtract: The Muntsluis (bridge no. 1) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. Although the bridge bears the name number 1, it is not the first bridge of Amsterdam. The name sluis is used here in the sense of "stone bridge", not a lock. The bridge is located over the place where the Singel flows into the Amstel.

name: Singelgrachtbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Houtmanspoorbrug, colloquially known as the Singelgrachtbrug, is a system of lift bridges in Amsterdam-Centrum, near the Spaarndammerbuurt district. The bridge spans the Westerkanaal with its western quay, the Houtmankade. Until November 2017, the bridge was known as S4 (rail bridge 4) or Singelgrachtbrug.

name: Wasknijper
wikipediaExtract: De Wasknijper (bridge 177) is a drawbridge in Amsterdam-Noord. The traffic bridge lies in the Distelweg and crosses the Buiksloterkanaal. It is the northernmost bridge over that canal.

name: Torensluis
wikipediaExtract: The Torensluis (bridge no. 9) is a characteristic arched bridge over the Singel in the inner city of Amsterdam and with 42 meters one of the widest in the city. The reason for this is that a tower stood on the bridge, the Jan Roodenpoortstoren.

name: Mariniersbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Mariniersbrug is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum with bridge number 272. The traffic bridge runs along the Kattenburgerstraat (S116) and spans the Dijksgracht. The Kattenburgerstraat then dips under the Kattenburgerspoorbrug to the north to the traffic junction with the Piet Heinkade (continuation S116).

name: Haardsteebrug
wikipediaExtract: The Haardsteebrug (bridge 1063) is a structure in Amsterdam-Zuidoost.

name: Isaac Israëlsbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Isaac Israëlsbrug, (Bridge 408), also known as Schildersbrug, is a bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. The bridge spans the Noorder Amstelkanaal and forms the connection between the Cornelis Schuytstraat and the Breitnerstraat.

name: Heibrug
wikipediaExtract: The Heibrug (bridge no. 4) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge spans the Singel and forms the connection between the Heisteeg (towards the center) and Wijde Heisteeg (towards the west). The bridge became necessary after the city expansion at the end of the 16th century, during which the western bank of the Singel was also built up.

name: Omvalbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Omvalbrug, bridge no. 429, is a movable bridge between the Amsterdam neighborhoods of Watergraafsmeer and Overamstel. The bridge is located near Amstel station and is located in Spaklerweg and crosses the Weespertrekvaart next to the elevated railway and metro track.

name: Haringpakkersbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Haringpakkersbrug (bridge 58) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is named after the Haring Pakkerye, the herring packers' works once located here. The name also survived in the Haringpakkerstoren, demolished in 1829 and standing north-west of the bridge's present position, and in the Haringpakkerssteeg.

name: Joep Langebrug
wikipediaExtract: Joep Langebrug (bridge 417) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Sloterbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Sloterbrug (bridge 9P) is a drawbridge within the municipality of Haarlemmermeer. The bridge belongs to Haarlemmermeer but is known in Amsterdam as bridge 9P, the P meaning not maintained by Amsterdam. Officially the bridge has no name.

name: Sint Nicolaasbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Sint Nicolaasbrug (bridge 306) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge spans the Open Havenfront and extends along the Damrak. The bridge connects the Prins Hendrikkade with the Stationsplein in front of Amsterdam Central Station. This led to its unofficial name Stationsbrug.

name: Timo Smeehuijzenbrug
wikipediaExtract: Timo Smeehuijzenbrug (bridge 407) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Veebrug
wikipediaExtract: The Veebrug (bridge 261) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Oost. It spans the Lozingskanaal and is located in the Veelaan. It provides the connection between the Zeeburgerpad and the Zeeburgerdijk. The Veelaan begins at the Cruquiusweg, crosses the Nieuwe Vaart via the Slachthuisbrug and connects to the Molukkenstraat across the Lozingskanaal.

name: Johanna Borskibrug
wikipediaExtract: The Johanna Borskibrug (bridge number 41) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies in the Vijzelstraat and spans the Keizersgracht.

name: Hanny Michaelisbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Hanny Michaelisbrug (bridge 405) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. The bridge is one of the four bridges that enclose the De Kom road network. The bridge crosses the Noorder Amstelkanaal, whose south bank is called Mozartkade. It connects Stadionweg with Hobbemakade.

name: Lex van Deldenbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Lex van Deldenbrug (bridge 808) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. The bridge is named after the composer Lex van Delden, other streets and squares in the area also received names that refer to composers. The bridge connects De Boelelaan with George Gershwinplein.

name: Halvemaansbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Halvemaansbrug (bridge 221) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It forms the connection between the two embankments of the Amstel (here called Binnen Amstel) in the city center of Amsterdam. On the north side there is still another embankment of the Kloveniersburgwal and 's-Gravelandseveer (embankment of the Amstel).

name: Klimopbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Klimopbrug (bridge 999) is a fixed bridge in the form of a viaduct in Amsterdam-Noord. It is located over the Nieuwe Leeuwarderweg, which is surrounded here by the Noorderpark and formerly the Volewijkspark.

name: Planciusspoorbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Planciusspoorbrug is a railway viaduct in Amsterdam-Centrum in the Netherlands. The bridge spans the north-south running Planciusstraat, its direct namesake, both are named after Petrus Plancius. Until November 2017, the bridge was known as S6 and S7 (rail bridge 6 and 7).

name: John Rädeckerbrug
wikipediaExtract: The John Rädeckerbrug (bridge 1916) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Oost. It is located in the Th. K. van Lohuizenlaan, formerly called IJburglaan until 1998 and crosses the Lozingskanaal. Together with the similar Ad Grimmonbrug (bridge 1915), it forms the connection between the Zeeburg district and the Cruquiuseiland.

name: Hartmanbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Hartmanbrug (bridge no. 190) is a plate bridge in Amsterdam-Oost. It is located in the Molukkenstraat and spans the Ringvaart. The bridge thus connects the Indische Buurt with the Watergraafsmeer. The quay along the Ringvaart is called Valentijnkade on the north side and Ooster Ringdijk on the south side.

name: Vondelbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Vondelbrug (bridge 200) is a fixed bridge in the form of a viaduct in Amsterdam-Zuid, connecting Amsterdam Oud-Zuid with Amsterdam Oud-West.

name: Oosterbeerbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Oosterbeerbrug (bridge 354) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Dirk de Waterduikerbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Dirk de Waterduikerbrug (bridge 617) is a fixed bridge in the Slotermeer district in the Amsterdam Nieuw-West district. The bridge is located in the Noordzijde street and crosses a culvert, which connects the water of the marina on the north side of the Sloterplas with a narrow canal that runs in a northerly direction.

name: Madibabrug
wikipediaExtract: The Madibabrug (bridge 1035) is a structure in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The bridge is located in the Karspeldreef and crosses the Reigersbospad. The Karspeldreef on the embankment body cuts through Nelson Mandelapark from east to west and is only accessible to fast traffic.

name: Gierzwaluwbrug
wikipediaExtract: Bridge 1189 or Gierzwaluwbrug is a structure in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The bridge is located in a footpath in the Bijlmerweide park and spans a ring water around an island. It is along the extension of bridge 1187. The first bridge built here dates back to 1970.

name: Elsje Christiaensbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Elsje Christiaensbrug (bridge 2474) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Noord. The traffic bridge is located over the Buiksloterkanaal and is located on Tolhuisweg.

name: M. Justbrug
wikipediaExtract: The M. Justbrug (bridge 803) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. The bridge is located in Van Nijenrodeweg in Buitenveldert. It spans a water that runs parallel to Van der Boechorststraat. The approximately 35 meters wide traffic bridge dates back to 1961.

name: Wiegbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Wiegbrug (bridge no. 173) is a movable bridge over the Kostverlorenvaart in Amsterdam-West, connecting the De Clercqstraat with the Admiraal de Ruijterweg. Its name refers to the type of bridge built here in 1904, a rolling bascule bridge.

name: L.H. Sarlouisbrug
wikipediaExtract: The L.H. Sarlouisbrug (bridge 240) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge is located in the Weesperstraat and spans the Nieuwe Keizersgracht. The bridge has a history similar to the Dr. Dünnerbrug and Dr. Meijer de Hondbrug, although it will be slightly older, due to the development of the city from the center.

name: Kabouterbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Kabouterbrug (Bridge 360) is a steel lift bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid that is only accessible to pedestrians and cyclists. The bridge is located on a continuous cycling route from Vondelpark via Schinkelhavenstraat towards Amsterdam Nieuw-West to Theophile de Bockstraat.

name: Nieuwe-Wercksbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Nieuwe-Wercksbrug (bridge no. 63) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It connects the Westermarkt with the Rozengracht, spanning the Prinsengracht at the Oude Wester.

name: Leidsebrug
wikipediaExtract: The Leidsebrug or Leidsepleinbrug, bridge no. 174, is a fixed plate bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum and crosses the Singelgracht. The bridge connects Leidseplein and Marnixstraat with Leidsebosje and Stadhouderkade. The bridge is named after the former Leidsepoort. The landheads and pillars were made of natural stone.

name: Walenweeshuissluis
wikipediaExtract: The Walenweessluis (bridge 70) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. Sluis here means a stone bridge. The bridge forms the connection between Vijzelstraat and the filled-in Vijzelgracht. It is located over the Prinsengracht. The name Walenweessluis is a name derived from the Walenweeshuis, the orphanage for children from the French or Walloon church.

name: Kadoelenbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Kadoelenbrug (bridge 1787) is a bridge in Amsterdam-Noord. The name refers to the Kadoelen area north of the bridge. It was built between 29 August 2011 and May 2013 for just under 2.5 million euros, although the official opening took place on 4 July 2012.

name: Isa van Eeghenbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Isa van Eeghenbrug is a fixed slab bridge with three openings in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Zaagpoort
wikipediaExtract: The Zaagpoort (bridge no. 161) is a fixed bridge between the center of Amsterdam and the Amsterdam-West district. The bridge connects on the one hand Marnixplein and Marnixstraat on the other hand Frederik Hendrikplantsoen and Nassaukade. It crosses the Singelgracht.

name: Westerdoksluis
wikipediaExtract: The Westerdoksluis is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It crosses the connection between the Westerdok and the IJ, carrying the Stadsroute 100 between the Westerdokskade and De Ruijterkade on the south side and the Westerdoksdijk on Westerdokseiland to the north.

name: Hannie Schaftbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Hannie Schaftbrug (bridge no. 601) is a structure in the Slotermeer district of Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: Leeuwenputbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Leeuwenputbrug (bridge 371) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Noord. This traffic bridge is located in the Grasweg and spans the Buiksloterkanaal. On the east side of the canal, the Grasweg exits onto the Ranonkelkade.

name: Ryckerbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Rijckerbrug or Ryckerbrug (bridge no. 167) is a fixed slab bridge between Amsterdam-Centrum and Amsterdam-West crossing the Singelgracht. It connects the Rozengracht, called the Verlengde Rozengracht while it was being built, with the De Clercqstraat, and has its western abutment in the Nassaukade.

name: Overschiebrug-Zuid
wikipediaExtract: The Overschiebrug-Noord (bridge 655) and Overschiebrug-Zuid (bridge 665) are two structures in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The two viaducts span the Overschiestraat. They provide the connection between the Henk Sneevlietweg and the Rijksweg 10/Ringweg-West.

name: Drs. P-brug
wikipediaExtract: The Drs. P-brug (bridge 2115) is a structure in Amsterdam-Noord. Its working name was the Ridderspoorbrug.

name: Lee Millerbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Lee Millerbrug (bridge 2080) is a bridge still to be built in Amsterdam-Oost. The bridge will be built in 2023 and 2024 and will provide the connection between Centrumeiland and Strandeiland within the IJburg district in Pampuslaan. The bridge will then span the Merdekagracht.

name: Koekjesbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Koekjesbrug (bridge no. 170) is a structure on the boundary of Amsterdam-Centrum and Amsterdam-West.

name: Mien Ruysbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Mien Ruysbrug (bridge 1944) is a structure in Amsterdam-Oost. The bridge was built in connection with the renovation of Park Frankendael. It had accumulated a backlog of maintenance over the years and was prepared for the modern era under the leadership of architectural firm Sant and Co by Edwin Santhagens.

name: Ina Boekbinderbrug
wikipediaExtract: Ina Boekbinderbrug (bridge 416) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. The bridge is located in the Minervalaan and spans the Zuider Amstelkanaal. Hendrik Petrus Berlage already drew this bridge on his plan for Plan Zuid from 1915. The width of the bridge was already quite narrow compared to the width of the Minervalaan.

name: Hein Donnerbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Hein Donnerbrug (bridge number 1922) is a structure on the border of Amsterdam-Centrum and Amsterdam-Zuid. The bridge was named after Jan Hein Donner in his capacity as a chess player in 1991. The fixed concrete bridge has spanned the Singelgracht since around 1988.

name: Oost-Indische Huisbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Oost-Indische Huisbrug (bridge 223) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge spans the Kloveniersburgwal and thus forms the connection between Russia and the southern quay of the Raamgracht. The bridge has been a municipal monument since October 10, 1995.

name: Piet Keizerbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Piet Keizerbrug (bridge 2234) is a structure in Amsterdam-Oost. The bridge is a pedestrian and bicycle bridge; it forms the connection between the Esplanade de Meer square and the Stade de Colombes (street). It lies parallel to the Sjaak Swartbrug over a decorative water.

name: Kattenslootbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Kattenslootbrug (bridge 155) is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-West.

name: Machineslootbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Machineslootbrug (bridge 358) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-West over the Admiralengracht.

name: Staatsliedenbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Staatsliedenbrug (bridge 139) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Oud-West. The bridge forms the connection between the Van Limburg Stirumstraat and the Tweede Nassaustraat. It spans the Kostverlorenvaart with its quays De Wittenkade.

name: Oude Kinkerbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Oude Kinkerbrug (bridge 169) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It connects the Elandsgracht with the Kinkerstraat, spanning the Singelgracht between them. The Appeltjesmarkt lies to its north-east and Amsterdam's police headquarters of 1941 to its south-east. The Europarking car park is also nearby.

name: Schollenbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Schollenbrug (bridge 340) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Oost. The traffic bridge lies in the Weesperzijde and spans the Ringvaart of the Watergraafsmeer at the Amstel.

name: M.S. Vaz Diasbrug
wikipediaExtract: The M.S. Vaz Diasbrug (bridge 238), is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge connects Jonas Daniel Meijerplein with Weesperstraat. It spans the Nieuwe Herengracht. The history of the bridge is similar to the L.H. Sarlouisbrug, Dr. Dünnerbrug and Dr. Meijer de Hondbrug in Weesperstraat.

name: Volewijckbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Volewijckbrug (bridge 2475) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Noord.

name: Vierwindstrekenbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Vierwindstrekenbrug (bridge no. 381) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-West.

name: Westerkeersluis
wikipediaExtract: The Westerkeersluis (bridge 346) is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-West. The bridge spans the Westerkanaal and is part of the Centrumring S100. It connects Van Diemenstraat with Tasmanstraat. North of the bridge, the wooden lock gates of the Westerkanaal flood barrier (lock 205) between the city and the IJ are visible.

name: Overschiebrug-Noord
wikipediaExtract: The Overschiebrug-Noord (bridge 655) and Overschiebrug-Zuid (bridge 665) are two structures in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The two viaducts span the Overschiestraat. They provide the connection between the Henk Sneevlietweg and the Rijksweg 10/Ringweg-West.

name: Corry Tendeloobrug
wikipediaExtract: The Corry Tendeloobrug (bridge 713) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The bridge is located on Johan Huizingalaan and spans a canal that runs parallel to Aletta Jacobslaan and Louwesweg on the north side. Aletta Jacobslaan becomes Louwesweg at the intersection with Johan Huizingalaan.

name: Johan Neeskensbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Johan Neeskensbrug (bridge 2237) is a structure in Amsterdam-Oost. The bridge is one of the few traffic bridges (most are only for slow traffic); it is located on Wembleylaan over a decorative water in the area near Park de Meer, Watergraafsmeer that rose from the ground here between 1998 and 2002.

name: Hortusbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Hortusbrug (bridge no. 239) is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge spans the Nieuwe Herengracht and thus connects the Muiderstraat with the Plantage Middenlaan.

name: Ina Boudier Bakkerbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Ina Boudier-Bakkerbrug (bridge 609) is a fixed bridge in the Slotermeer district of Amsterdam. The bridge is located in Burgemeester Fockstraat and spans the Burgemeester van Tienhovengracht. The bridge was built to open up Slotermeer-Noord. The bridge has its landheads in Gerbrandypark and the southern quay of the aforementioned canal.

name: Solitudobrug
wikipediaExtract: The Solitudobrug (bridge 2190) is a structure in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Ger van Zanenbrug
wikipediaExtract: Ger van Zanenbrug (bridge 2372) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West, serving as the successor to bridge 700.

name: Piet Bakkerbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Piet Bakkerbrug (bridge number 715) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The traffic bridge, over which bus line 63 also runs, is located in Pieter Calandlaan and spans the Christoffel Plantijngracht.

name: Hans Kressebrug
wikipediaExtract: Bridge 716 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The pedestrian and bicycle bridge spans the Christoffel Plantijngracht, which runs parallel to the Christoffel Plantijnpad. It is located at the height of the Johan Brakensiekhof and the Theo Mann-Bouwmeesterhof.

name: Jan Evertsenbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Jan Evertsenbrug (145p) is a structure in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. Although it carries the name of a bridge, it is a system of viaducts and bridges; Amsterdam usually calls viaducts bridges. The viaduct and bridge system, entirely made of concrete, is located in the Ringweg Amsterdam and spans the Jan Evertsen and a parallel waterway.

name: Korte Ouderkerkerbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Korte Ouderkerkerbrug (bridge 1962) is a bicycle and pedestrian bridge located in the Overamstel district on the right Amstel Riverbank in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Doelensluis
wikipediaExtract: The Doelensluis (bridge 220) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Kinkerbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Kinkerbrug (bridge no. 266) is a bridge over the Kostverlorenvaart in Amsterdam-West. It connects the Kinkerstraat with the Postjesweg and the Witte de Withstraat, and between 1990 and 2010 formed the boundary between the former boroughs of De Baarsjes and Oud-West.

name: Lau Mazirelbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Lau Mazirelbrug (bridge 259) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge was named in 1982 after lawyer and resistance fighter Lau Mazirel (1907-1974). The traffic bridge forms the connection between the quay of the Nieuwe Keizersgracht, the Nieuwe Kerkstraat and Roetersstraat from the southwest and the Plantage Kerklaan from the northeast.

name: Joes Kloppenburgbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Joes Kloppenburgbrug, bridge no. 5, is a slab bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It connects the Raamsteeg with the Oude Spiegelstraat and crosses the Singel. It is a relatively narrow and slightly humped bridge with three openings for shipping, decorated with a granite artwork.

name: Pastoorsbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Pastoorsbrug (bridge 55) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is located on the southern quay of the Brouwersgracht and crosses the Keizersgracht. It is therefore the northernmost bridge over that canal that does not continue on the other side of the Brouwersgracht.

name: Lijnbaansbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Lijnbaansbrug (bridge 10) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge connects the Lijnbaanssteeg with the southern quay of the Blauwburgwal and spans the Singel. There has been a bridge here for centuries. The bridge is drawn on Pieter Bast's map dating from 1599. There the bridge lies in the Lijnbaan Steech, towards the Blaeuwe Burchwal.

name: Varkenssluis
wikipediaExtract: The Varkenssluis (bridge no. 204) is a bridge over the Oudezijds Voorburgwal in the Wallengebied area of Amsterdam. The bridge connects Damstraat with Oude Doelenstraat. A bridge has been lying here for centuries. It can already be seen on city maps by Pieter Bast (1599) and Balthasar Florisz. van Berckenrode (1625).

name: Hendrick Jacobsz Staetsbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Hendrick Jacobsz. Staetsbrug (bridge 35) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is located on the western bank of the Amstel and spans the Herengracht, which ends here. On the other side, the canal continues, but under the name Nieuwe Herengracht, starting at the Walter Süskindbrug. There has been a structure here for centuries.

name: Radioweg
wikipediaExtract: The Velibor Vasovićbrug (bridge 1906) is a structure in Amsterdam-Oost. A concrete bridge, but then under number 426, provided the connection between the Watergraafsmeer district and the neighboring municipality of Diemen from 1983. These were then separated by the Ringweg-Oost and a ring ditch of Diemen. A single span was chosen at the time.

name: Zeilbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Zeilbrug or Zeilstraatbrug (bridge no. 348) is a bridge over the Schinkel in Amsterdam. The bridge connects Zeilstraat and Hoofddorpweg and forms a connection between Oud-Zuid and the Hoofddorpplein neighborhood. Various documents from the municipality of Amsterdam only mentioned bridge 348; Zeilbrug was apparently not an official name.

name: Theo Fransmanbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Theo Fransmanbrug (bridge number 1788) is a structure in Amsterdam-Noord. The Papaverweg in the Buiksloterham area was a dead-end road from buildings to Zijkanaal I for almost a century. There was also a docking harbor called Papaverkanaal where for years there was a drainage depot from the City Cleaning Department.

name: Tante Saarbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Tante Saarbrug (bridge 31) is a fixed arch bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Wim Suurbierbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Wim Suurbierbrug (bridge 2239) is a structure in Amsterdam-Oost. The bridge is one of the traffic bridges (the others are for slow traffic) that forms the connection within the Park de Meer neighborhood within the Watergraafsmeer, which rose from the ground here between 1998 and 2002.

name: Johan Cruijffbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Johan Cruijffbrug (bridge 2238) is a structure in the Dutch district of Amsterdam-Oost. The bridge is a pedestrian and bicycle bridge; it forms the connection between the Esplanade de Meer square and the Anfieldroad (street) towards Middenweg. It lies parallel to the Johan Neeskensbrug over a decorative water.

name: Willemsbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Willemsbrug (bridge 151) is a bridge in Amsterdam-West over the Singelgracht between the Haarlemmerplein and the Nassauplein. This bascule bridge is named after the nearby Willemspoort. The construction of a bridge at this location became necessary after the construction of the Westerkanaal in 1877.

name: Oetewalerbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Oetewalerbrug (bridge no. 189) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Oost. It spans the Ringvaart of the Amsterdam Watergraafsmeer. It provides the connection between Linnaeusstraat, until 1878 Oetewalerweg, and Middenweg in the former Overamstelse Polder with the Watergraafsmeer drainage works.

name: Fré Cohenbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Fré Cohenbrug is a fixed bridge with a culvert in Watergraafsmeer, Amsterdam. The bridge is located in the Zaaiersweg in Betondorp and spans the Molenwetering, which comes from under the Rinus Michelsbrug in the Middenweg. That Molenwetering also forms a ring ditch westward around the Nieuwe Oosterbegraafplaats.

name: Westerdoksdijkspoorbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Spoorbrug Westerdokseiland (bridge no. 19S) is a former railway bridge in Amsterdam. It connected the tracks of Centraal Station with the goods yard then on Westerdokseiland.

name: Pia Beckbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Pia Beckbrug (bridge number 1868) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Slotervaart in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The bridge was built to open up a neighbourhood whose streets are named after jazz musicians such as Louis Armstrong, Duke Ellington and Count Basie.

name: Tulpbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Tulpbrug (bridge 255) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam, on the border of the districts Centrum and Oost. The bridge forms the connection between Professor Tulpplein with the Amstel Hotel and the Huddekade on the one hand and the Weesperzijde on the other. It spans the Singelgracht.

name: De Duifbrug
wikipediaExtract: De Duifbrug, Duyfjesbrug or Duyfjessluis is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is located on the eastern quay of the Reguliersgracht across the Prinsengracht.

name: Brug 69
wikipediaExtract: Brug 69 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge connects the Spiegelgracht with the Nieuwe Spiegelstraat and crosses the Prinsengracht. On Jacob Bosch's map showing the Fourth Extension from around 1679, the bridge is already drawn.

name: Brug 51
wikipediaExtract: Brug 51 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Duizendste Brug
wikipediaExtract: Bridge in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

name: Kors van Bennekombrug
wikipediaExtract: Kors van Bennekombrug (Bridge 2009) is a structure in Amsterdam-Oost. The bridge is located in the Vennepluimstraat and provides the connection between the northern and southern part of the Westelijk Haveneiland in IJburg. It crosses the Groene Tunnel canal.

name: Bullebaksluis
wikipediaExtract: The Bullebakssluis (bridge number 160) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is a different bridge from De Bullebak, further along the Marnixstraat.

name: Han Lammersbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Han Lammersbrug (bridge no. 2202) is a pedestrian and cyclist bridge over the Westerdok in Amsterdam. The bridge connects the Westerdokskade with the Westerdokseiland, a former railway yard of NS that was redeveloped in the early 21st century as a residential area.

name: Marten Toonderbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Marten Toonderbrug (bridge 48) is a masonry vaulted bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge forms the connection between Wolvenstraat and Berenstraat and spans the Keizersgracht there. There was already a bridge here for centuries. The bridge that was there in 1902 had to deal with defects due to the amount of traffic going over it.

name: Van Mierlobrug
wikipediaExtract: Van Mierlobrug (bridge 18) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge connects the southern quay of the Blauwburgwal with Herenstraat. It spans Herengracht in the process. The bridge forms a whole with bridge 19 on the eastern quay of Herengracht and over the Blauwburgwal.

name: Piet Meerburgbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Piet Meerburgbrug (bridge 234) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge spans two parallel culverts. These culverts connect an ornamental pond in the Hortus Botanicus Amsterdam with the water of the Nieuwe Keizersgracht.

name: Frans Hendriksz Oetgensbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Frans Hendricksz. Oetgensbrug (bridge 76) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is located on the western quay of the Amstel and spans the Prinsengracht. The bridge is the last bridge of the Prinsengracht before it flows into the same Amstel. The bridge is also on the southeastern border of the Amsterdam canal belt.

name: Lucas Jansz Sinckbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Lucas Jansz Sinckbrug (bridge no. 36) is a bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum in the canal belt. It is located on the western quay of the Amstel and spans the Keizersgracht. It is therefore the last bridge over the Keizersgracht, which ends here.

name: Wim Sonneveldbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Wim Sonneveldbrug (bridge 175) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies in the Marnixstraat and spans the Leidsegracht. It was placed in 1935/1936 to a plain design by Piet Kramer, with no ornament or sculpture.

name: Ruud Krolbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Ruud Krolbrug (bridge 2232) is a structure in Amsterdam-Oost. The bridge is one of the pedestrian and bicycle bridges in the area of Park de Meer, Watergraafsmeer that rose from the ground here between 1998 and 2002. That area is completely surrounded by a water channel/ring ditch.

name: Weteringpoort
wikipediaExtract: The Weteringpoort was one of the eight Amsterdam city gates that were built during the Third and Fourth Extensions of the city. The Weteringpoort, which was part of the fortifications of Amsterdam, was one of the smaller city gates together with the Raampoort and Zaagmolenpoort.

name: Horst Blankenburgbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Horst Blankenburgbrug (bridge 2293) is a structure in Amsterdam. The bridge is one of the few traffic bridges (most are only for slow traffic) that forms the connection between Watergraafsmeer and the Park de Meer neighborhood, which was built here between 1998 and 2002.

name: Zouthavenbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Willem Breukerbrug (bridge 2326) is a structure in Amsterdam-Centrum. Until 10 January 2024 it was called the Zouthavenbrug.

name: Brug 75
wikipediaExtract: Brug 75 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is located in the Utrechtsestraat and crosses the Prinsengracht. It is the last bridge of the Utrechtsestraat towards the city, the once built bridge over the Achtergracht was demolished when that canal was filled in.

name: Groentemarktbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Groentemarktbrug (bridge 156) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge is located in Marnixstraat. It spans a passage between on the one hand (on the center side) the Lauriergracht (with bridge 110 over it) and Lijnbaansgracht and on the other hand (west side) the Singelgracht.

name: Rie Beisenherzbrug
wikipediaExtract: Rie Beisenherz (8 September 1901 – 12 April 1992) was a Dutch swimmer. She competed in the women's 100 metre freestyle event at the 1920 Summer Olympics, reaching the semifinals. She was the first woman to represent the Netherlands at the Olympics.

name: Brug 331
wikipediaExtract: Brug 331 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-West over a cooling-water channel. Bridge 391, a railway bridge, lies about 10 metres to its north. Twenty metres further on lies the pairing of bridge 330 (road) and bridge 390 (rail) carrying the Nieuwe Hemweg over the same channel.

name: Brug 46
wikipediaExtract: Brug 46 (formerly Quellijn brug) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is located on the northern quay of the Leidsegracht and spans the Keizersgracht. Surrounding the bridge are buildings on all eight quays that have been designated as national monuments. The bridge itself could not be declared a monument, it is too young for that.

name: Brug 47
wikipediaExtract: Brug 47 is a vaulted bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge connects Huidenstraat with Runstraat and crosses the Keizersgracht in the area of the Negen Straatjes in the Amsterdam canal belt.

name: Jacoba van Tongerenbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Jacoba van Tongerenbrug (bridge number 602) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West, Slotermeer. The traffic bridge is located in Burgemeester Fockstraat and spans the Afwateringstocht. It leads to the southern Gerbrandypark. The bridge was built in 1953 according to a design by Piet Kramer from 1950 (the date stones mention 1951).

name: Henriëtte van Heukelom-van den Brandelerbrug
wikipediaExtract: Henriëtte van Heukelom-van den Brandelerbrug is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. The bridge leads to the entrance and exit of Beatrixpark from/to Prinses Irenestraat. The bridge is located over an edge water/drainage ditch of the aforementioned park. It was designed in 1969 by architect Dirk Sterenberg working at and for the Department of Public Works.

name: Sloterdijkerbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Sloterdijkerbrug (bridge 321) is a double wooden drawbridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It spans the Prinseneilandsgracht. It not only forms the main route between Sloterdijkstraat on the mainland and Galgenstraat on Prinseneiland, but also between both quays of that canal Nieuwe Teertuinen and Prinseneiland, the street.

name: Haarlemmersluis
wikipediaExtract: The Haarlemmersluis is a 17th-century lock in the center of Amsterdam. The lock is located at the eastern end of the Brouwersgracht, on the site where the Singel flows into the IJ. The fixed bridge (bridge number 14) near the lock connects the Nieuwendijk and Haarlemmerstraat. The lock is a popular tourist attraction.

name: Brug 142
wikipediaExtract: Brug 142 is a drawbridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge forms the connection between Willemsstraat and Nieuwe Willemsstraat. It spans the Lijnbaansgracht. In 1882, a wooden emergency bridge was built here, as the local connection across the Lijnbaansgracht at the level of Palmstraat was demolished. It was not until 1887 that a tender was made.

name: Keizersbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Keizersbrug (bridge 286) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is located along the extension of the Korte Koningsstraat and crosses the Oudeschans.

name: Brug 89
wikipediaExtract: Brug 89 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is located in the Weteringstraat. It spans the Lijnbaansgracht. The end of the bridge joins the Weteringpoort (bridge 90). The bridge is an anachronism. A bridge has been lying here for centuries.

name: Krijtbergbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Krijtbergsluis (bridge no. 3) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is located on the southwestern quay of the Singel and spans the Beulingsloot in the Amsterdam canal belt.

name: Bullebak
wikipediaExtract: The Bullebak, bridge 149, is a double bascule bridge in Amsterdam over the Brouwersgracht, which connects the Marnixkade, the Marnixstraat with the Korte Marnixstraat at the level of the Marnixkade. The bridge is made of wood, steel, brick and concrete.

name: Veenderijbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Veenderijbrug (bridge number 639) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The bridge is located in the Osdorperweg and spans the Osdorpervaart to the Osdorper Binnenpolder. There has been a bridge here since the 1920s, when the draining of the polder began.

name: Peter Postbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Peter Postbrug (bridge 2162) is a structure in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The district Laan van Spartaan, in which this bridge is located, was developed in the early 21st century. Sports fields, once located on the outskirts of the city, were increasingly built on and Amsterdam needed space for housing.

name: Meerbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Meerbrug (Bridge 308) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Noord. The bridge is located in the Kadoelenweg and crosses a ditch that runs parallel to the north side of the Stoombootweg. There was already a bridge here in the times when the municipality of Landsmeer still had land here.

name: Brug 97
wikipediaExtract: Brug 97 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is located on the southeastern quay of the Spiegelgracht, spans the Lijnbaansgracht and leads to the Weteringschans, locally once called Verlengde Spiegelgracht (but there was no canal) and Zieseniskade. Along the extension of the bridge is the Museumbrug to the Rijksmuseum.

name: Caroline Herschelbrug
wikipediaExtract: Caroline Herschelbrug (bridge 115) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Oost. This pedestrian bridge connects Celebesstraat with the Ooster Ringdijk and spans the ring canal of Watergraafsmeer. A bridge with a budget of 5500 guilders was built there in 1927. The bridge was designed at the time by Piet Kramer of the Department of Public Works.

name: Henrietta Leavittbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Henrietta Leavittbrug is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam, Watergraafsmeer. The bridge, formerly known as the anonymous bridge number 195, spans the Ringvaart of the Watergraafsmeer near the halfway point of the Tie-Breakers tennis park and the Flevopark, located on the western banks of the Nieuwe Diep.

name: Ezelsbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Ezelsbrug (bridge no. 1904) is a structure in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Gustav Leonhardtbrug
wikipediaExtract: Gustav Leonhardtbrug (bridge 449 is a fixed bridge in Beatrixpark in Amsterdam-Zuid. The bridge is only suitable for pedestrians and cyclists, and leads to entrance/exit Willem Landréstraat in the composers' neighborhood.

name: Drieharingenbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Drieharingenbrug (bridge 320) is a double lift bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge forms the connection between the Realeneiland and the Prinseneiland and spans the Realengracht. It lies southwards along the extension of the Vierwindendwarsstraat and leads to the Prinseneiland street.

name: Camera Obscurabrug
wikipediaExtract: The Camera Obscurabrug (bridge 322) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It is located in the extension of the Leeuwendalersweg southwards. It spans the Erasmusgracht, which west of the bridge is named Burgemeester Van Tienhovengracht.

name: Witte Boogbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Witte Boogbrug (bridge 469), named after its appearance, is a structure in Amsterdam-Noord. It is located on Monnikendammerweg. It spans a local pond. The bridge was built as a viaduct. It was designed in the mid-1960s as part of the intersection of the Monnikendammerweg and the Zuiderzeeweg.

name: Pieter Goemansbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Pieter Goemansbrug is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is named after lyricist Pieter Goemans and was previously unofficially known as Bestedelingenbrug and/or Bestedelingensluis after the once nearby Bestedelingenhuis (a home for orphans and paupers, or bestedelingen).

name: Brug 96
wikipediaExtract: Brug 96 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is located on the western quay of the Prinsengracht and crosses the Passeerdersgracht. There has been a bridge here for centuries. On the map of Balthasar Florisz. van Berckenrode from 1625, the bridge is already drawn as a bridge over the Prince Graft and Passeerders Graft.

name: Grimnessesluis
wikipediaExtract: The Grimnessesluis (bridge 202) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The short traffic bridge provides the connection between the east side of the street section of the Rokin and the Oude Turfmarkt. It spans the small waterway between the Grimburgwal and the same Rokin, but then open water.

name: Johnny & Jonesbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Johnny & Jonesbrug (bridge 433) is a fixed bridge in the Prinses Irenebuurt in Amsterdam-Zuid. The pedestrian bridge is located over the entrance to the circular central large pond of Beatrixpark. It is located next to the "permanent botanical garden". In the immediate vicinity stands the sculpture Penguins by Jan Trapman.

name: Brug 94
wikipediaExtract: Brug 94 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is located over the Leidsegracht and forms the connection between the Raamdwarsstraat (north) and the quay of the Lijnbaansgracht (south).

name: Commandantsbrug
wikipediaExtract: Commandantsbrug is the unofficial name of bridge 2361 in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Brug 72
wikipediaExtract: Brug 72 and Brug 73 are two fixed bridges in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridges are located in the banks of the Prinsengracht and cross the Reguliersgracht. Bridge 73 is on the city side (north side, odd numbers), bridge 72 on the outside side (south side, even numbers). The bridges are surrounded by municipal and national monuments.

name: Cecilia van Alphen-Jagtmanbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Cecilia van Alphen-Jagtmanbrug (bridge 912) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Noord. It forms the connection between the western Buiksloterdijk and a T-intersection on the eastern side. The Buiksloterdijk has a side road here between house numbers 240-242 (a municipal monument) and 248, which runs northeast.

name: Brug 87
wikipediaExtract: Brug 87 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is located on the western quay of the Prinsengracht and spans the Spiegelgracht. Next to bridge 87 is bridge 69 spanning the Prinsengracht. Both bridges are surrounded by municipal and national monuments. The bridge is already drawn on the 1675 plan by Jacobus de la Feuille.

name: Brug 24
wikipediaExtract: Brug 24 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It forms the connection between Gasthuismolensteeg and Hartenstraat. It spans the Herengracht. The bridge, itself not a monument, is surrounded by municipal and national monuments. There has been a bridge here for centuries.

name: Brug 21
wikipediaExtract: Brug 21 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is located on the western quay of the Herengracht and spans the Leliegracht. The bridge forms a whole with the Anton Jolingbrug (bridge 20), which crosses the Herengracht at a 90-degree angle. There has been a bridge here for centuries.

name: Wil de Graaffbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Wil de Graaffbrug (bridge 393) is a pedestrian bridge in Amsterdam-West. The bridge is located in the northeast of Erasmus Park and spans the Erasmusgracht, which lies just outside the park. The bridge lies in line with the Lof der zotheidbrug (bridge 394). The bridge dates back to 1970, when the park was completely redesigned at what was then great cost.

name: Jan Swammerdambrug
wikipediaExtract: The Jan Swammerdambrug (bridge 2291) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Oud-West. The bridge connects the Bilderdijkkade (the western bank of the Bilderdijkgracht) with the Tweede Constantijn Huygensstraat. It spans the Jacob van Lennepkanaal.

name: Geert Geertsenbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Geert Geertsenbrug (bridge 395) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-West. The pedestrian bridge is located on the western edge of Erasmus Park and provides access from Hondiusstraat and Mercatorstraat. It spans the ring moat surrounding the park. Near the entrance is the restaurant Terrasmus (location 2022) located in the park.

name: Han van Zomerenbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Han van Zomerenbrug (bridge 402) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. The wooden bridge that is only accessible to pedestrians (a traffic sign indicates that cyclists should disembark!) has been the connection between Pieter Lodewijk Takstraat and Waalstraat since 2009.

name: Galgenbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Galgenbrug (bridge 315) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is located between Bickerseiland and Prinseneiland. It was built between 1625 (the map by Balthasar Florisz. van Berckenrode from 1625 does not show the bridge) and 1649 (the map by Joan Blaeu does show the bridge).

name: Brug 812
wikipediaExtract: Brug 812 is a structure in Amsterdam-Zuid. This bridge was built around 1963 in a footpath between De Cuserstraat and Kalfjeslaan. The path crosses 't Kleine Loopveld and lies over a pond south of De Cuserstraat 3.

name: Brug 81
wikipediaExtract: Brug 81 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is located on the northern quay of the Lijnbaansgracht and spans the Reguliersgracht.

name: Staalmeestersbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Staalmeestersbrug (bridge 227) is a drawbridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It spans the Groenburgwal and is located in Staalstraat, which lies on both sides of the Groenburgwal. It is next to bridge 226, the only bridge over the canal.

name: Pelikaanbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Pelikaanbrug (bridge number 277) is a lifting bridge from 1984 in Amsterdam-Centrum, near the Oosterkerk. The bridge spans the Nieuwe Vaart, from the Hoogte Kadijk in the south to the Wittenburgergracht in the north. The bridge is exclusively accessible to pedestrians and cyclists.

name: Vier Heemskinderenbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Vier Heemskinderenbrug, also known as Vier Heemskinderensluis, is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is located on the western quay of the Herengracht and crosses the Leidsegracht. It has been a municipal monument since 1995 and is surrounded by national monuments.

name: Brug 19
wikipediaExtract: Brug 19 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge is located on the eastern quay of the Herengracht and spans the Blauwburgwal. The bridge forms a whole with bridge 18 on the southern quay of the Blauwburgwal and over the Herengracht.

name: Brug 52
wikipediaExtract: Brug 52 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge is located on the western quay of the Keizersgracht and spans the Leliegracht. Seen from the centre, the Leliesluis is located just behind this bridge. It is flanked by the bridges 51 (next to it) and 53 (across the Keizersgracht).

name: Brug 53
wikipediaExtract: Brug 53 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge is located on the eastern quay of the Keizersgracht and spans the Leliegracht. It is flanked by bridges 51 (next to it) and 52 (across the Keizersgracht). The bridge, itself not a monument (it is too young for that), is surrounded by national monuments.

name: Solitudolaanspoorbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Solitudolaanspoorbrug and its namesakes, the Solitudolaan and the Solitudopad, lie in Amsterdam-Oost. The Solitudolaan and -pad received their names in 2015, when new residential buildings were built in this area and road redevelopment took place. The railway bridge was named after the avenue in February 2018.

name: Lyceumbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Lyceumbrug (bridge 410) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. It connects Olympiaplein with Pieter Lastmankade and Jan van Goyenkade, the northern quays of the Noorder Amstelkanaal.

name: Groentepraambrug
wikipediaExtract: The Groentepraambrug (bridge 129) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-West. The footbridge connects Van Kinsbergenstraat with Cabotstraat and spans the Admiralengracht. The bridge is located between the Molenslootbrug and the Machineslootbrug and was built because the distance between these two traffic bridges, about 700 meters, is quite large for pedestrians.

name: Zebrabrug
wikipediaExtract: The Zebrabrug is a structure in Amsterdam and a temporary work of art in Leiden.

name: Maria Woestenburgbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Maria Woesthovenbrug (bridge 620) is a fixed bridge in Geuzenveld-Slotermeer, Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The bridge is located in Lodewijk van Deysselstraat and spans an unnamed canal. The bridge dates back to around 1955, when the district was built. The bridge was designed by the Department of Public Works.

name: Hennetjesbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Hennetjesbrug (bridge 179) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Oud-West. The bridge is located in Nicolaas Beetsstraat and spans the Jacob van Lennepkanaal. Southeast of the bridge was the former site of the Wilhelmina Gasthuis.

name: Tetje de Jongbrug
wikipediaExtract: Tetje de Jongbrug (bridge 100) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is located on the eastern quay of the Lijnbaansgracht and spans the Looiersgracht. This canal has only three bridges, the Looierssluis (bridge 103), bridge 102 and this bridge 100. Bridge 101, the Nieuwe Amstelbrug, spans the Amstel, so elsewhere in the city.

name: Reesluis
wikipediaExtract: The Reesluis (bridge 64) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Kees Fensbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Kees Fensbrug (bridge number 49) is a fixed vaulted bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge forms the connection between the Hartenstraat and Reestraat and spans the Keizersgracht. There had already been a bridge here for at least a century when the municipality of Amsterdam decided in 1881 that it should be lowered.

name: Majoor Bosshardtbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Majoor Bosshardtbrug (bridge no. 211) is a bridge over the Oudezijds Achterburgwal on the Wallen in Amsterdam. The bridge connects the Molensteeg with the Oudekennissteeg. There has been a bridge here for centuries.

name: Muiderbergbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Muiderbergbrug (bridge 989) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Noord. The foot and bicycle bridge is along the Markengouw in Nieuwendam. The bridge dates back to 1968/1969 and consists of concrete (a concrete span, concrete pillars, concrete abutments) with blue painted steel balustrades. This color is more common in this area.

name: Rotterdammerbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Rotterdammerbrug (bridge 150) is a fixed bridge on the border of Amsterdam-Centrum and Amsterdam Oud-West. The bridge spans the Singelgracht between Marnixstraat and Nassaukade. On the east side, the bridge opens into Eerste Marnixplantsoen, built on the former Bolwerk Haarlem, one of the 17th-century Amsterdam bastions.

name: Liefdesbruggetje
wikipediaExtract: The Liefdesbruggetje (bridge 172) is a bridge in Amsterdam Oud-Zuid. The footbridge is the most easterly located of the three bridges in Sarphatipark. It spans the drainage system of the park. The water is pumped up from a pond just before the bridge; then the water flows through an artificial water channel/fall into the large pond.

name: Steenhouwerijbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Steenhouwerijbrug or Steenhouwerijsluis (bridge 45) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The arched bridge is located on the northeast bank of the Keizersgracht and crosses the Leidsegracht. The bridge gets its name from the Stadsmetseltuin that was located on the Leidsegracht during the planning of this neighborhood.

name: Kattenrugbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Katterug (bridge no. 1935) is a bridge over the Hugo de Grootgracht in Amsterdam-West. The bridge connects the foot and bicycle path joining the Van Reigersbergenstraat and the Hugo de Grootkade to the Bilderdijkpark, and lies in line with the Bilderdijkkade.

name: Huntumbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Huntumbrug (bridge 1041) is a structure in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The viaduct was built in the Karspeldreef, an important traffic route for fast traffic that runs from east to west through the district. It spans the Bijlmerpleinpad, a foot and bicycle path that winds from north to south through the district.

name: Zaanlijn
wikipediaExtract: The Zaanlijn is the Uitgeest-Amsterdam section of the Den Helder-Amsterdam railway. It runs through the Zaanstreek and takes its name from the fact that much of the line runs parallel to the river Zaan.

name: Brug 390
wikipediaExtract: Brug 390 is a fixed bridge in Westpoort, Amsterdam. It is a railway bridge that was built over the cooling water canal of the Centrale Hemweg. It lies parallel to the traffic bridges numbered 330. Like bridge 330, the railway bridge has three passages, but shipping of any kind is impossible here.

Bridge 1128 is a structure in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The bridge is a so-called culvert bridge. It was laid in 1968/1969 in a wide drainage ditch between the G-District with Geerdinkhof and the Bijlmerweide park. The park and the water were laid out around half of the neighbourhood.

name: Brug 73
wikipediaExtract: Brug 72 and Brug 73 are two fixed bridges in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridges are located in the banks of the Prinsengracht and cross the Reguliersgracht. Bridge 73 is on the city side (north side, odd numbers), bridge 72 on the outside side (south side, even numbers). The bridges are surrounded by municipal and national monuments.

name: Brug 388
wikipediaExtract: Brug 275 is a fixed railway bridge in Westpoort, Amsterdam. The bridge with a single track crosses the mouth of the Tweede Koelwaterkanaal of the Centrale Hemweg. It dates from the mid-seventies and was designed by Sier van Rhijn, later responsible for buildings etc. of the Amsterdam metro East Line.

name: Groene spechtbrug
wikipediaExtract: Bridge 1186 or Groene spechtbrug is a structure in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The bridge is located on a footpath in the Bijlmerweide park and spans a ring lake around an island. The first bridge built here dates back to 1970.

name: Goudvinkbrug
wikipediaExtract: Bridge 1187 or Goudvinkbrug is a structure in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The bridge is located on a footpath in the Bijlmerweide park and spans a ring lake around an island. The first bridge built here dates back to 1970. Dirk Sterenberg of the Public Works Department designed a nearly ten-meter-long wooden footbridge that did not have bridge pillars.

name: Aandammerbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Aandammerbrug is a single drawbridge that connects the Poppendammergouw in Amsterdam-Noord (Landelijk Noord) with the Aandammergouw in Zuiderwoude (Waterland municipality).

name: Armeensebrug
wikipediaExtract: The Armeensebrug (bridge 293) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It connects Keizersstraat across the Krom Boomssloot with Korte Keizersstraat. For shipping, the passage width is 5.50 m; the passage height is 1.80 m at canal level of NAP - 0.40 m. The bridge is surrounded, except on the northeast side, by municipal and national monuments.

name: Atlas Maiorbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Atlas Maiorbrug (bridge 120) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is one of the four bridges over the Bloemgracht. It is the third from the city. It forms a north-south connection between the Derde Leliedwarsstraat (north) and the Tweede Bloemdwarsstraat (south).

name: Atochabrug
wikipediaExtract: The Atochabrug is a structure in Amsterdam-Noord. This bridge with number 937 was built in the 2010s as a connection between two parts of the Buikslotermeerplein.

name: Bakkersbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Bakkersbrug (bridge 375) is a largely wooden lift bridge in Zunderdorp in Amsterdam-Noord.

name: Ballenbrug
wikipediaExtract: Bridge 516 is a structure in the Amsterdamse Bos in the municipality of Amsterdam. The Amsterdamse Bos is located in part in the municipality of Amstelveen, while the municipality of Amsterdam manages it. A multitude of bridges in that forest was designed by Piet Kramer, bridge architect at the Department of Public Works, and this is one of them.

name: Bet van Beerenbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Bet van Beerenbrug (bridge no. 210, formerly also known as the Stormsteegbrug) is a bridge over the Oudezijds Achterburgwal in the Wallengebied in Amsterdam. The bridge connects the Korte Niezel with the (Korte) Stormsteeg. There has been a bridge here for centuries.

name: Blauwezandbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Blauwezandbrug (bridge 92) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Noord. It forms the connection between the Waddendijk and the Rode Kruisstraat. It spans the ring ditch of Tuindorp Buiksloot near the Grote Die. The bridge was designed in 1939 by Piet Kramer of the Department of Public Works.

name: Bongerdbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Bongerdbrug is a swing bridge in Amsterdam-Noord. At the beginning of the 21st century, the industrial area and community garden complex De Bongerd was converted into a residential area.

name: Brandweerbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Brandweerbrug, bridge number 79, is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam and is located on the border of the neighborhoods of De Pijp and the Museum Quarter in Amsterdam-Zuid. The bridge has been connecting the two banks, Hobbema- and Ruysdaelkade, of the Boerenwetering since 1879.

name: Brantasbrug
wikipediaExtract: Brantas (bridge 1993) is a structure in Amsterdam-Oost. The concrete traffic bridge is located in the Sumatrakade and spans the Brantasgracht. It is one of the four traffic bridges located on the Sumatrakade road and spans the dug canals on the island of Java.

name: Cor van der Hartbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Cor van der Hartbrug is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Oost. It is located on the edge of the Sportheldenbuurt on the Zeeburgereiland. It is located along the Alida van den Bosstraat, spans the ring ditch of the district and leads to the Bobby Harmslaan. From the bridge, three silos of the former sewage treatment plant can be seen heading towards the city.

name: Corsgenbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Corsgenbrug (bridge 12) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: De Arendbrug
wikipediaExtract: De Arendbrug (bridge 1973) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-West. The bridge forms the connection between the Haarlemmerweg and the Polonceaukade, both of which are the quays of the Haarlemmertrekvaart, which it spans. The bridge lies approximately along the Van Hallstraat. North of the bridge are the former gas holders of the Westergasfabriek.

name: Diaconessenbrug
wikipediaExtract: Diaconessenbrug (bridge 454, was also known as: Willemsbrug) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. The bridge formed the connection between Vondelpark (on the northern side of the bridge) and Willemspark (on the southern side), from which it derives its popular name.

name: Druivenbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Druivenbrug (bridge 1796) is a double lift bridge in Amsterdam-Noord. The bridge spans the Noordelijke singel in the 21st-century district of De Bongerd. It connects Druivenstraat (its namesake, itself named after the grape) with the Bongerdkade and lies parallel to the outlet of Zijkanaal I, along which the mentioned cycle path runs.

name: Eenhoornsluis
wikipediaExtract: The Eenhoornsluis (bridge no. 313) is a bridge over the Korte Prinsengracht in Amsterdam. The bridge lies between the Haarlemmerstraat and Haarlemmerdijk and dates from 1618. The bridge and the associated Eenhoornschutsluis (lock no. 103) were planned as a connection of the then new canals with the IJ, since 1832 the Westerdok, when the canal belt was built.

name: Ernst Cahn en Alfred Kohnbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Ernst Cahn en Alfred Kohnbrug is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. The traffic bridge over which tram line 4 also runs forms the connection between Van Woustraat and Rijnstraat. It spans the Amstelkanaal here with the northern Jozef Israëlskade and southern Amstelkade.

name: Evert van der Wallbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Evert van der Wallbrug is a fixed bridge for pedestrians and cyclists in Amsterdam-Oost. It is located in the Watergraafsmeer in the extension of the Mr. P.N. Arntzeniusweg and spans the Ringvaart van de Watergraafsmeer. It connects the Linnaeuskade and Oranje-Vrijstaatkade, both banks of that ringvaart.

name: Gerard Revebrug
wikipediaExtract: Gerard Revebrug (bridge 403) is a fixed plate bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. The fixed traffic bridge spans the Amstelkanaal (called the Zuider-Amstelkanaal while it was being built) and connects the Tweede van der Helststraat with the Maasstraat.

name: Geurt Brinkgrevebrug
wikipediaExtract: The Geurt Brinkgrevebrug (bridge number 296) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge is located on the eastern quay of the Krom Boomssloot and crosses the Recht Boomssloot. It is the middle bridge in the Recht Boomssloot.

name: Godenbrug
wikipediaExtract: Bridge 411 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid, over the Noorder Amstelkanaal. Until 2016 it went by three unofficial names; 'Godenbrug' comes from the names of gods that streets in this neighbourhood were said to have been given. It was designed by Piet Kramer in the Amsterdam School style.

name: Grote Brouwerssluis
wikipediaExtract: Bridge 62 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is located on the eastern quay of the Prinsengracht and crosses the Leliegracht. The bridge forms the end of the Leliesluis, a former lock complex from the time when the Prinsengracht formed the edge of the city.

name: Havankbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Havankbrug (bridge 1265) is a structure in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The bridge was built around 1984 as a connection between two parts of the Venserpolder district, which are separated by a canal. It was built in a series of four foot and bicycle bridges: bridge 1263, bridge 1264, bridge 1265 and bridge 1266.

name: Hederabrug
wikipediaExtract: The Hederabrug (bridge 998) is a fixed bridge in the form of a viaduct in Amsterdam-Noord. It is located over the Nieuwe Leeuwarderweg, which is surrounded here by the Noorderpark and formerly the Volewijkspark.

name: Heiligewegsluis
wikipediaExtract: The Heiligewegsluis (bridge no. 2) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge provides the connection between the western quay of the Singel and the Heiligeweg.

name: Hein de Haanbrug
wikipediaExtract: Bridge 2037 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Oost, IJburg. It is located in the Jan Olphert Vaillantlaan and runs from the Steigereiland across the IJmeer to the Diemerzeedijk on the "mainland" (there are many ponds and inland waters here).

name: Helsingforsbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Helsingforsbrug (bridge 2421) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-West. The name refers to the Finnish Baltic Sea port Helsinki. Amsterdam chose the Swedish name "Helsingfors" for the naming, because during the timber trade with the Baltic Sea regions Finland was a part of Sweden.

name: Hilletjes Brug
wikipediaExtract: Bridge in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

name: Hollandse Iepbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Hollandse Iepbrug (bridge 2470) is a movable bridge over the Noord-Hollandsch Kanaal in Amsterdam-Noord. The name is derived from the monumental Dutch elm that had to be moved out of the way in 2021 for the construction of the embankment connection.

name: Ir. B. Bijvoetbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Ir. B. Bijvoetbrug (bridge 229) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge spans the Zwanenburgwal.

name: Jaap Kunstbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Jaap Kunstbrug (bridge 1926) is a structure in Amsterdam-Oost. The bridge is one of the three bridges that span the large pond of the Oosterpark. The bridge looks very similar to the Klaartje de Zwarte-Walvischbrug.

name: Karel van het Revebrug
wikipediaExtract: The Karel van het Revebrug (Bridge 676) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The bridge is located in a separate pedestrian and bicycle path. That path runs partly parallel to Christoffel Plantijnpad in Sloterpark Oost, a park-like environment on the eastern bank of the Sloterplas in the Western Garden Cities.

name: Kleine Brouwerssluis
wikipediaExtract: Bridge 67 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum, carrying the north quay of the Leidsegracht over the Prinsengracht. Until April 2016 it was known as the Kleine Brouwerssluis. In December 2021 it was named after Angenietje Swart, one of Amsterdam's wet nurses, women who took in foundlings.

name: Kolksluis
wikipediaExtract: The Kolksluis is a fixed bridge (bridge 302) and lock (lock 108) in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is located in the Zeedijk and spans the Oudezijds Kolk in the heart of Amsterdam. The bridge is located in the Wallengebied. The bridge is surrounded by national monuments on both the dike and the kolk.

name: Korrelbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Korrelbrug (bridge 143) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Kraansluis
wikipediaExtract: The Kraansluis (bridge 300) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is located in the Prins Hendrikkade and crosses the mouth of the Waalseilandgracht to the Open Havenfront. The bridge is located in the aforementioned quay in the extension of bridge 301 (Kolkwaterkering) and bridge 299 (Hoofdbrug).

name: Kunstbrug
wikipediaExtract: Kunst (bridge 1987) is a structure and a structure in Amsterdam-Oost. The wrought iron footbridge is located on the island of Java and spans the Majanggracht. That canal was dug at a time when the island of Java became a residential destination with gardens in between.

name: Lekkeresluis
wikipediaExtract: The Lekkeresluis (bridge 59) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is located on the southern quay of the Brouwersgracht and spans the Prinsengracht. The bridge is located where the Prinsengracht flows into the Brouwersgracht, across the Brouwersgracht it continues under the name Korte Prinsengracht.

name: Leliesluis
wikipediaExtract: The Leliesluis (bridge no. 61) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It spans the Prinsengracht and connects the north bank (just to the side) of the Leliegracht to the other side of the Prinsengracht in the western canal belt.

name: Leonard Springerbrug
wikipediaExtract: Leonard Springerbrug (Bridge 159) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Oost. It is located near the entrance to the park on Linnaeusstraat. From the bridge the Muiderkerk can be seen: the original church from 1892 until a fire destroyed it in 1989, and since then a new building with the original tower that the fire spared.

name: Liesdelsluis
wikipediaExtract: The Liesdelsluis (bridge no. 207) is a fixed bridge in the Wallengebied in Amsterdam-Centrum. The suffix "sluis" refers to "stone bridge" here. The bridge spans the Oudezijds Voorburgwal and thus connects the Lange Niezel with the Korte Niezel.

name: Loenermarkbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Loenermarkbrug (bridge 935) is a structure in Amsterdam-Noord. The bridge was built in 1966/1967 as part of a cycling route along the Leeuwarderweg in Amsterdam-Noord. It was built at the same time as bridge 940 (Loenermark/IJdoornlaan; demolished) and bridge 958; the bridges also show some outward similarity.

name: Louis J. Welterbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Louis J. Welterbrug (bridge 794) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The bridge for pedestrians and cyclists is laid over the Rudi Bloemgartensingel (named after Rudi Bloemgarten).

name: Lübeckbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Lübeckbrug (bridge number 2429) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-West. The name refers to the German port city of Lübeck, which was important for the timber trade with Amsterdam.

name: Maria Skłodowska-Curiebrug
wikipediaExtract: The Maria Skłodowska-Curiebrug is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Oost. The bridge is located in the southern extension of the Kramatweg, where it crosses the Watergraafsmeer ring canal and connects to the Valentijnkade. The bridge, intended only for pedestrians and cyclists, was built by Waternet.

name: Moddermolenbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Theo Boschbrug (bridge 230) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is named after the Amsterdam architect Theo Bosch (1940-1994). The bridge is located on the western quay of the Zwanenburgwal and crosses the Raamgracht.

name: Moeder Alacoquebrug
wikipediaExtract: Bridge in Amsterdam, the Netherlands.

name: Montelbaansbrug
wikipediaExtract: Brug 280 or Montelbaanbrug is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is located on the northwestern quay of the Oudeschans, which is called Kalkmarkt in the north by the way. It spans the Waalseilandsgracht. Except for one building, all the buildings here have been declared a municipal or national monument.

name: Mr. J.J. van der Veldebrug
wikipediaExtract: The Mr. J.J. van der Veldebrug (bridge 1939) is a bridge for cyclists and pedestrians over the Oosterdok in Amsterdam. The bridge connects the Oosterdokseiland with the NEMO building, on top of the southern end of the IJ tunnel, the so-called IJtunnelpier.
displayName: Mr. J. J. van der Veldebrug

name: Museumbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Museumbrug (bridge number 82) is a fixed bridge on the border of Amsterdam-Centrum and Amsterdam-Zuid, the Museum Quarter. The bridge connects the Weteringschans with the Stadhouderskade and spans the Singelgracht. For pedestrians and cyclists, it is the link between the Spiegelgracht and the Passage Rijksmuseum.

name: Na Druk Gelukbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Na-Druk-Geluksbrug (bridge number 696) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam. The bridge provides the connection between the Burgerweeshuispad and the area around the Olympic Stadium. It spans the Stadiongracht here. The bridge does not have public transport, but is suitable for all traffic, although this is only allowed in the northbound direction.

name: Niek Engelschmanbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Niek Engelschmanbrug (bridge 106) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It connects Raadhuisstraat with Westermarkt, crossing the Keizersgracht in the process. A bridge was built here in the 1890s, when first the Warmoesgracht was filled in and later a breakthrough was made between the Herengracht and Keizersgracht to create a route in and out of the city.

name: Nijlpaardenbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Nijlpaardenbrug (bridge 1907) is a pedestrian and cyclist lift bridge from 1987 in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge crosses the Entrepotdok and was built during the period when the warehouses of the dock were converted into houses. A walking and cycling route also came between the Plantage and Eastern Islands.

name: Noordsche Compagniebrug
wikipediaExtract: The Noordsche Compagniebrug (bridge 54) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge connects Herenstraat with Prinsenstraat and crosses the Keizersgracht. The bridge, itself a municipal monument since 1995, is surrounded by national monuments.

name: Oesjesduiker
wikipediaExtract: The Oesjesduiker (bridge 114) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge-cum-culvert is located where the Wittenburgervaart crosses into the Nieuwe Vaart. It thus connects the Wittenburgergracht with the Oostenburgergracht, both quays of the Nieuwe Vaart. There has been a crossing here for centuries.

name: Oliphantsbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Oliphantsbrug (bridge 1957) or Olifantsbrug is a bridge on the border of Amsterdam-Centrum and Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Oosterdoksdraaibrug
wikipediaExtract: The Oosterdoksdraaibrug is a combination of two swing bridges in the centre of Amsterdam that connects the eastern half of the Oosterdokseiland with the Dijksgracht. It is a pedestrian and bicycle bridge 53 meters long and 5 meters wide, with the pivot on a small dam, a so-called middenklip.

name: Oranjebrug
wikipediaExtract: The Oranjebrug (bridge 146) is a lift bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The street runs along the Buiten and Binnen Oranjestraat, then crosses the Brouwersgracht and then barely connects to the Willemsstraat. The latter has to do with the fact that that street was a canal when the bridge was built and renovated (Goudsbloemgracht).

name: Oudekerksbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Oudekerksbrug (bridge 206) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is officially named after the nearby Oude Kerk, but previously bore the names Minnebroersbrug (after the Minnebroederssteeg) and Molsteenbrug (after the Molsteeg).

name: Paerlduiker
wikipediaExtract: Paerlduiker is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge connects the Kattenburgergracht and Wittenburgergracht, both "canals" being only quays of the Nieuwe Vaart. It therefore also forms a connection between Kattenburg and Wittenburg. It spans the southern extension of the Kattenburgervaart.

name: Papiermolensluis
wikipediaExtract: The Papiermolensluis is a vaulted bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. Sluis is the "old" word for a stone bridge, although there was also a lock here. The traffic bridge forms the connection between the eastern quay and the odd side of the Prinsengracht and the corresponding quay and side of the Korte Prinsengracht. It crosses the Brouwersgracht.

name: Paulusbroedersluis
wikipediaExtract: The Paulusbroedersluis (bridge no. 215) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It spans the Oudezijds Achterburgwal in the Wallengebied in Amsterdam. The bridge thus connects the Oude Doelenstraat with the Oude Hoogstraat. The bridge owes its name to the Sint-Paulusbroederklooster that stood here in the Middle Ages.

name: Pesthuysbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Pesthuysbrug (bridge 181) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Oud-West.

name: Petemayenbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Petemayenbrug is a double drawbridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The name is said to be derived from petemoeien (godmother), also a term for old women. It connects Bokkinghangen with Zandhoek, both western docks of the Westerdok. Bokkinghangen is located on the former Bolwerk Blauwhoofd (Zeeheldenbuurt), Zandhoek on the Realeneiland.

name: Piet Dickentmanbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Pieter Dickentmanbrug is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Oost. It is located on the edge of the Sportheldenbuurt on the Zeeburgereiland. It lies along the Nida Senffstraat and crosses the moat to the IJburglaan. The bridge was built in a package of five, which all have the same design.

name: Piet Peelenbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Piet Peelenbrug (bridge 786) is a fixed bridge in Osdorp, Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The foot and bicycle bridge from 1984 forms the connection between the Verlengde Hoekenespad and Stadspark Osdorp and spans the Hoekenesgracht. On the west side of the bridge are two of the four sculptures from the sculpture group Markering by Adriaan Rees.

name: Prinsensluis
wikipediaExtract: The Prinsensluis (bridge no. 60) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Rachel Ruyschbrug
wikipediaExtract: Bridge 25 is a bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It forms the connection between the Oude Spiegelstraat and the Wolvenstraat in the area of the Negen Straatjes in the Amsterdam canal belt. It spans the Herengracht. The bridge has three passage openings, the widest is 5.65 meters wide and has a height of 1.79 meters.

name: Retirobrug
wikipediaExtract: The Retirobrug (bridge 920) is a structure in Amsterdam-Noord.

name: Rita Reysbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Rita Reysbrug (bridge number 1866) is a fixed bridge in Slotervaart, Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The bridge was built to open up a neighbourhood whose streets are named after jazz musicians such as Chet Baker, Duke Ellington and Count Basie.

name: Rosa Overbeekbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Rosa Overbeekbrug (bridge no. 121) is a bridge over the Bloemgracht in the Jordaan in Amsterdam. The bridge connects the Eerste Bloemdwarsstraat with the Tweede Leliedwarsstraat. There has been a bridge here for centuries. Both Balthasar Florisz. van Berckenrode and Joan Blaeu included a bridge in their plans from 1625 and 1649.

name: Roskambrug
wikipediaExtract: The Roskambrug is a bascule bridge in the North Holland city of Weesp and crosses the Smal Weesp and connects the Casparuslaan with the Prinses Irenelaan. Here the roads along the banks of the Smal Weesp were called the Korte Stammerdijk on the north side and the Buitenveer on the south side.

name: Scharrebiersluis
wikipediaExtract: The Scharrebiersluis (bridge 278) is a lift bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is named after scharrebier, a cheap beer of moderate quality that was bought on site here by waiting captains.

name: Schellingwouder Kerkepadsbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Schellingwouder Kerkepadbrug (bridge 377) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Noord. For a long time, the bridge was the only option for access to the Schellingwouderkerk from the Schellingwouderdijk.
