Since shipping took place on the Binnenbermsloot, which it spans, there was a drawbridge.

name: Schottenburchsbrug
wikipediaExtract: Bridge 292 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It forms the connection between Koningsstraat and Korte Koningsstraat and crosses the Krom Boomssloot over it. Around the bridge are a number of municipal and national monuments.

name: Sint-Jansbrug
wikipediaExtract: Sint Jansbrug is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum in the De Wallen area.

name: Sleutelbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Sleutelbrug is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The vaulted bridge with three openings is located on the southern quay of the Grimburgwal and spans the Oudezijds Voorburgwal. From the bridge you have full visibility of the buildings of the former Binnengasthuis. The bridge is surrounded by municipal and national monuments.

name: Smederij Meisterbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Smederij Meisterbrug (bridge 164) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Oud-West. It spans the Bilderdijkgracht and forms the connection between the Kwakersplein (center side) and the Kwakersstraat and both quays of the canal.

name: Snoekjesbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Snoekjesbrug (bridge 289) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge is located over the Snoekjesgracht and extends along the Snoekjessteeg. The bridge is located halfway across the already short canal. On the southwest side of the bridge are a number of municipal and national monuments.

name: Titus Brandsmabrug
wikipediaExtract: The Titus Brandsmabrug (bridge 792) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The traffic bridge is located in the De Aker district in the Middelveldsche Akerpolder. The bridge dating from around 1990 forms the connection between the Geertruida van Lierstraat and Nisserstraat and crosses the Ernst Cahnsingel.

name: Truus Wijsmullerbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Truus Wijsmullerbrug (bridge 793) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The traffic bridge is located in the De Aker district in the Middelveldsche Akerpolder. The bridge dating from around 1990 forms the connection between Jacob Paffstraat and Inaristraat and crosses the Ernst Cahnsingel.

name: Uiverbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Uiverbrug (bridge 2208) is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is located in the Generaal Vetterstraat and spans the Riekerhaven to the Valschermkade. The Uiverbrug is intended as a traffic bridge, the adjacent bridge 307 (also known as the Riekerhavenbrug) of the Jaagpad is intended only for pedestrians and cyclists.

name: Vingboomsbrug
wikipediaExtract: Bridge 26 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum, linking the Wijde Heisteeg and the Huidenstraat over the Herengracht. It was unofficially called the Vingboonsbrug, after the architect Philips Vingboons, who designed the so-called Vingboons houses at Herengracht 362–370. In 2016 all unofficial bridge names lapsed.

name: Vluchthavenbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Vluchthavenbrug (bridge 1927) is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. This pedestrian bridge was built around 2012 around a harbor that had emerged between the Westerdoksdijk and a new building complex called IJdock. The bridge was designed by architectural and engineering firm Ney & Partners.

name: Vredenburgerbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Vredenburgerbrug (bridge no. 209) is a pedestrian bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It spans the Oudezijds Achterburgwal in the Wallengebied and is therefore the northernmost bridge over that canal before it converges with the Oudezijds Voorburgwal to Oudezijds Kolk. The bridge connects the Vredenburgersteeg with the Spooksteeg.

name: Westergasbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Westergasbrug (bridge 193) is an iron lifting bridge in Amsterdam-West. The bridge is not exactly along the extension of Van Limburg Stirumstraat, on the other side of its intersection with the Haarlemmerweg. It spans the Haarlemmervaart and provides access to the grounds of the former Westergasfabriek, its namesake.

name: Wetlandbrug
wikipediaExtract: Bridge 1541 is a structure in the Amsterdamse Bos. The Amsterdamse Bos is located on the grounds of the municipality of Amstelveen, but the municipality of Amsterdam manages it. The bridge leads to a dike that lies in the middle of the wetlands water.

name: Wim Ibobrug
wikipediaExtract: Wim Ibobrug (bridge 1774) is a bridge in Amsterdam-Noord. The bridge was built as a connection between the dead-end roads Grasweg and Distelweg. It spans the Tolhuiskanaal. The bridge was built in the early 1990s and is almost entirely made of concrete.

name: Witte Katbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Witte Katbrug (bridge number 1914) is a structure and a structure in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Zaandijksspoorbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Zaandijkspoorbrug is a railway bridge in Amsterdam-West. This railway bridge is a viaduct, or a tunnel, under the Oude Lijn between the Westerpark to the south and the Spaarndammerbuurt to the north. The all-concrete structure was built around 1979 to provide a better connection between the aforementioned park and neighborhood.

name: Zandbrug
wikipediaExtract: Bridge 225 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum, carrying the east quay of the Kloveniersburgwal over the Raamgracht. For years it went by the name Zandbrug, after the nearby Zandstraat and Zanddwarsstraat. In 2016 the city withdrew all unofficial names, and on 14 May 2025 it named the bridge after Seraphina van Brazilië.

name: Zandhoeksbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Zandhoeksbrug (bridge 316) is a double lift bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It spans the Realengracht, where it connects to the Westerdok. On the northern side of the bridge is the Realeneiland with the northern quay of the Realengracht and Zandhoek, the western quay of the Westerdok.

name: Zonnewendebrug
wikipediaExtract: The Zonnewendebrug (bridge 2106) is a structure in Amsterdam-Centrum. The name refers to June 21 (21-06) on which the solstice takes place annually.

name: Zoutkeetsbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Zoutkeetsbrug (bridge 318) is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is located along the extension of Planciusstraat (northwards) and spans the Zoutkeetsgracht. It thus forms the connection with the Zoutkeetsplein located north of the bridge in the Zeeheldenbuurt.

name: Zuidergasfabriekbrug
wikipediaExtract: The Zuidergasfabriekbrug, or bridge 311, is a double lift bridge located in the Amstelkwartier neighborhood of the Overamstel district on the right Amstel Riverbank in Amsterdam-Oost.
